title: The Double-Entry Engine: Day Book & Daily Balanced Journals

intro.title: Day Book & Balanced Journals
intro.subtitle: Double-entry ledger engine, automatic debit-credit balancing, and voucher audit trails

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 8, Part 1: The Double-Entry Engine: Day Book and Daily Balanced Journals. Behind every sale, purchase, and payment, MediFlow automatically creates double-entry debit and credit vouchers.
Go to Accounting. The Day Book presents an audited chronological record of all posted financial vouchers across Cash, Bank, Sales, and Purchase accounts.
Every transaction enforces strict double-entry balance, ensuring total debits equal total credits with zero suspense accounts.
Filter vouchers by date range or transaction type to audit cash receipts, distributor payments, and tax liability postings.
Open any journal entry to inspect ledger account codes, reference numbers, and user audit trails. In Part 2, we settle Customer Khata accounts!

outro.takeaway: Double-Entry Engine: Maintain balanced general ledgers with automatic journal postings for every pharmacy sale, purchase, and expense.
